findings.title: JSDoc for excludeOperatorFamily is misleading: it says undefined means auto-detect via detectSupabase, but the auto-fallback is driven by the permissions.isSupe
findings.label: trivial

findings.title: Restrict permissions on the written .env.production.local file. writeFileSync writes production credentials (CS_CLIENT_KEY) with the default umask (typically 0o
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: writeFileSync uses default permissions like any .env file the user writes; this is minor hardening on an experimental, opt-in command.

findings.title: flush() is not idempotent despite the JSDoc claim; render() iterates over the full entries array each time, so calling flush() twice writes duplicate entries.
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: The JSDoc overstates idempotency, but run.ts calls flush only once per path, so no duplicate entries occur in practice.

findings.title: force: true silently overwrites user customizations in .claude/skills/<name>/; the confirm prompt doesn't mention that existing files will be clobbered.
findings.label: valid
findings.note: cpSync with force:true overwrites existing .claude/skills/<name> files, and the confirm prompt does not warn that they will be overwritten.

findings.title: Early return on the first existing candidate dir may skip the real migrations directory; rewriteEncryptedMigrations returns on the first DRIZZLE_OUT_DIRS entry
findings.label: valid
findings.note: rewriteEncryptedMigrations returns after the first existing candidate dir even if the drizzle out dir is a different one, so real migrations can go unrewritten.

findings.title: Duplicate matches when a single line triggers multiple kinds (e.g. .from(users) and .update(users) on one line), producing two report entries for the same sourc
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: Separate regexes can tag one line with different kinds (e.g. select and update), which is arguably correct and only affects a report.

findings.title: env --write is wired but undocumented in HELP. flags.write is read but the HELP text for the env command and the flags block don't mention --write.
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: --write is missing from the help text of an experimental command.

findings.title: Auto-fallback triggers on !isSuperuser regardless of whether permissions are already sufficient, so non-superuser roles with explicit grants are silently downgr
findings.label: incorrect
findings.note: Creating operator classes/families needs superuser in Postgres, so falling back to the no-operator-family variant for non-superusers is needed, not a wrongful downgrade.

findings.title: err.message duplicates noise now that stderr streams to the terminal; logging it mostly restates the generic 'Command failed' text.
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: This is only about how verbose the logging is.

findings.title: process.exit(1) is used instead of the p.cancel + return pattern used by other cancellation paths, skipping future cleanup and making the function harder to tes
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: This is about the code pattern and testability.

findings.title: Redundant defaultValue/initialValue pairing in the clientPath prompt.
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: The redundant prompt options are a style issue.

findings.title: Generated config uses non-null assertion on DATABASE_URL; if unset, downstream code receives undefined and fails with a less helpful error than an explicit thro
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: The non-null assertion in the scaffolded config only affects the error message.

findings.title: Use path.join instead of manual string concatenation; hard-coded forward slashes won't handle Windows paths cleanly.
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: This is a style nit about building paths by hand.

findings.title: .pooler.supabase.com is already covered by .supabase.com; the third branch is dead.
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: The extra suffix check is redundant but harmless.

findings.title: "Next.js precedence" isn't exactly Next.js: .env.development is loaded unconditionally regardless of NODE_ENV.
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: This is about whether the comment's 'Next.js precedence' wording is accurate.

findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: This is a hypothetical about a future change to packages/drizzle, not a defect caused by this PR.
